title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Desk Reference Card — Paying Off a Commercial Account by Phone
content:
When an owner, principal or authorized buyer of a business holding a pay-in-full commercial account asks to pay the account off in full by phone, the payoff payment is one debit from the business's bank account by phone ACH for the payoff figure, authorized and submitted by the business itself.

A payoff payment is recorded as one payment line held on account under its payment reference, and it is applied to the open invoices and charges on the next statement.

## Scope

The payoff covers the Ridgeline Commercial Account tiers of Ridgeline Pro Credit — Net 30, Net 30 Select, Net 45 and Net 60 Enterprise. The request comes from an owner, principal or authorized buyer of the business, and the debit is for the payoff figure of the account on the payment date.

## When the payoff figure is fixed

The payoff figure is fixed only after the latest closed statement, when it shows more days past due than the tier's late charge grace days, carries a late payment charge on the ledger.

The payoff figure is not fixed until every invoice dispute standing approved on the account has its dispute credit on the ledger.

## The payoff payment

The payment is made with the task tool `submit_payoff_payment_22b2623b`, which belongs to the business: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, handing it over, and the customer themselves then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool` to authorize and submit the debit.

**Capability.** One call debits the business's bank account once by phone ACH, credits one payment line to the Ridgeline Pro Credit account today, held on account under a new payment confirmation reference, and lowers the account's current balance by the amount paid. The business sees the payment and its confirmation reference in the account's activity.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_account_id` | The reference number of the Ridgeline Pro Credit account being paid, as read out by the agent from the Pro Credit account lookup | Identifier |
| `payment_amount` | The amount debited from the business's bank account | USD, a positive number rounded to 2 decimal places; debited exactly as given |

### Return

On success the tool returns `status` "credited", `trade_transaction_id` (the reference number of the new payment line), `payment_reference` (the phone payment confirmation reference, text beginning PH-), `payment_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `transaction_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `current_balance` (the account balance after the payment, USD, 2 decimal places). The tool's contract defines no other outcome.
